requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of financial transactions while optimizing processing speed.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and maintain an immutable audit trail.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions for at least 7 years, ensuring accountability.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms that work in tandem with two-factor authentication.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring essential functionalities during outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30%.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
